description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: sofa along right exterior wall facing left toward TV; dining table with four chairs in centre of living zone. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook can see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen, straight corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children (only one bedroom); households needing a home office or dedicated workspace (no desk or extra room); roommates needing separate private bedrooms.
not_suitable_for: households needing a home office or dedicated workspace (no desk or extra room)
